definitions: A member of an ancient nomadic people of Iranian origin who migrated from Central Asia to southern Russia and Ukraine in the 8th–7th centuries BC.
The extinct East Iranian language of the Scythians.
examples: The Scythian culture was known for its elaborate gold artifacts.
Archaeologists have uncovered numerous Scythian burial mounds.
The Scythian language is primarily known from inscriptions and loanwords in other languages.
